shortDescription: Six short games for ages 5–11. English learning activities with a localized interface.
longDescription:
Six games with Pip cover math, spelling, reading, multiplication, logic and vocabulary. All learning activities and narration are in English; the interface supports 19 language variants. Hints and retries let children practice at their own pace. One explorer and starter practice are free. Optional monthly or annual Family Premium adds more activities, up to four explorers, parent assignments and family summaries. Amazon shows local prices before confirmation. Purchases and Restore are in the PIN-protected parent area. Premium needs periodic Internet verification; installed activities play offline while access is valid. Progress stays on your device. No ads, public chat or microphone recording. Narration needs an installed offline English voice. This is selected practice, not a complete curriculum or independently teacher-approved content.

Learning activities and narration are in English
